name: Anxious Me
source:
Lada Zorina, a second-year student, has never dated anyone. She has hardly any friends, either. Lada is determined to turn her social life around, though she doesn't yet fully realize that the biggest obstacle standing in the way of her bright [s]communist[/s] future is herself. Lada suffers from social anxiety. How can you become friendly and bold when interacting with others if your insides knot up every time you want to speak to your classmates? Or when your stomach feels like it’s turning upside down the moment you want to ask a question during a lecture? Join her on a journey of self-improvement and decide whether she’ll blossom into a confident social butterfly or spend her unforgettable university years in dreary solitude.
